process.title: A six-step climb, not a checklist.
process.subtitle: Same journey, every partner, every time — from the first “what if” conversation to the moment your product is live and someone's actually watching it.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.lead: We ask about the business first, not the software.
steps.desc: What does this actually need to do, who's it for, and what happens if we get it wrong? Half the value here is us telling you what you don't need yet.

steps.title: Planning
steps.lead: You get a plan, not a guess.
steps.desc: We scope the real build — every phase is mapped from day one, even the parts we won't mention to you until they're relevant.

steps.title: Design
steps.lead: Shaped around how it's actually used.
steps.desc: Interfaces shaped around how the thing will actually be used, not a moodboard. If it's for someone standing at a counter with a customer waiting, it looks nothing like a dashboard built for someone at a desk — and we design accordingly.

steps.title: Development
steps.desc: Typed, tested, and reviewed — we write it so the next engineer, yours or ours, thanks us instead of rewriting it from scratch.

steps.title: Testing
steps.lead: We break it before your customers do.
steps.desc: Edge cases, bad connections, the fields people fill in wrong — tested against how people actually behave, not how the spec says they should.

steps.title: Launch
steps.desc: Deploy platform, CI/CD, content migration, gradual rollout — whatever's still shaky on launch day, we're the ones on it, not a support ticket queue.

cta.title: Not sure what you need?
cta.subtitle: That's exactly what the first call is for.
cta.description: Every business is unique. We'll help you identify the right solutions for your specific needs and budget.
